tasks.gr9-visual-arts-t1: Topic: Visual Arts. Cover advanced drawing techniques, perspective (one-point and two-point), proportion, shading (hatching, crosshatching), 2D and 3D planning, atmospheric perspective, and composition balance. Ask Grade 9 learners to identify perspective types, apply shading techniques, explain proportion in objects, describe compositional choices, and plan artworks with depth.
tasks.gr9-music-t1: Topic: Music. Cover improvisation within structures, scales and tonal patterns, phrasing in melodies, ensemble accuracy, notation review, and technical control. Ask Grade 9 learners to identify improvisation prompts, explain scales and patterns, recognize phrasing, assess ensemble balance, read notation, and demonstrate rhythmic accuracy.
tasks.gr9-drama-t1: Topic: Drama. Cover devised drama, role and character development, mood and atmosphere, conflict and tension, stage space usage, and physical theatre techniques. Ask Grade 9 learners to explain devised processes, describe role choices, analyze mood creation, identify conflict sources, describe stage positioning, and discuss physical expression.
tasks.gr9-dance-t1: Topic: Dance. Cover technique and alignment, travelling and non-locomotor steps, dynamics and contrast, body conditioning safety, posture control, and expressive movement. Ask Grade 9 learners to describe proper alignment, identify step types, explain dynamic variation, assess conditioning importance, and discuss expressive qualities in phrases.
